meta.name: Pabitra Puppies
meta.description: A game is deciding the fate of a group of friends, as they drop dead one inside their own homes. But how?

videos.title: Lockdown Diaries
videos.overview: The homebound members of the #PabitraPuppies group start playing an online game. But they soon realize that this game will change their fate.

videos.title: Love in the Times of Corona
videos.overview: The other members of #PabitraPuppies try to recover from the sudden shock. Little do they know that there’s more left for them.

videos.title: Return of Lenin
videos.overview: There’s a stranger, KM, who sneaks into the game of #PabitraPuppies members. Who is this mystery man and what is his motive?

videos.title: Labyrinth of Death
videos.overview: Are the deaths of the #PabitrapPuppies members really suicides - or murders? As the investigation continues, the players choose a new risk.

videos.title: Aguner Poroshmoni
videos.overview: The final phase of the deadly game begins! Is there going to yet another murder, or will the killer be caught before that?
